messages:
Maya (Product): Quick update: Hosted API  Structured Streaming + Tool Protocols v1 is GA today at 18:00 PT. Stable schema validation, improved chunk ordering, and clearer error codes. Docs: https://internal.redwood.ai/docs/streaming-tool-protocols-v1 :tada:

Ethan (DevEx): Nice! Will we ship SDK helpers? Need examples for stream parsing and tool result binding.

Maya (Product): Yes, DevEx will publish SDK 1.2.0 with `ToolProtocolV1` and `stream.parse()` helpers. We also provide a fallback shim for simple v0 users but recommend migrating.

Ivy (Eng): Rollout plan: canary @ 10% for 20m, 40% for 40m, then full if no regressions. No forced cutover; v0 deprecated in 60 days.

Rory (SRE): Creating dashboards for per-route streaming latency and schema-reject rates. PagerDuty trigger if schema rejects >4% for 5m.

Hana (Legal): Reminder: any schemas that include PII keys must have audit flags enabled for Dedicated/Private. We'll update the compliance playbook.

Maya (Product): Good point. Default: audit logging ON for Private/Dedicated, opt-in for Hosted. Migration checklist pinned after release.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started: structured-streaming-tool-protocols-v1 @10% (id: dpl_2026_09_12_1887654321)

Ethan (DevEx): Small curl snippet I'll add to the quickstart:
```bash
curl -N https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"mosaic-lite","input":"check_events","tool_protocol":{"name":"events","schema":{"start":"string","end":"string"}}}'
```

Ivy (Eng): If validators spike, I'll open a hotfix branch. Ping me directly.

Rory (SRE): Canary health: initial instances healthy. 0 schema errors after 10m. Monitoring hooks live.

Maya (Product): I'll post a customer-facing blurb to #release-notes and pin migration steps here. Thanks team!
